singular_emotional_truth: A groove built from voices: the lead sings while chopped and stacked vocals lock into the beat.
negative_constraints: Do not bury the lead vocal.
Do not let the chopped vocals lose their rhythmic identity.
overall_diagnosis: Overall mix readiness 68.8/100. Static balance 80.0/100; dynamic movement 28.2/100. The mix is more balanced than it is alive — invest in section contrast and rides, not more EQ.
biggest_risks: Chorus 1 may not lift enough relative to the previous section (only +1.4 dB and -0.03 width). Target roughly +3 to +5 dB and +0.05 to +0.10 width via supporting elements and automation, not master level.
